_readme: Homepage copy (Version 1.7). Select Work cards are drawn from each case study's frontmatter in src/content/work/.

hero._note: Version 1.4 hero. The name is title case and repeats as a moving stream behind the subject; the separator between repeats is an em dash, which is deliberate typography and the one place an em dash is allowed on the site. The descriptor renders uppercase through CSS so assistive technology reads it as a sentence.
hero.name: John Cowin

work.heading: Select Work
work.copy: The examples below show how I move from strategy through execution and coordinate the people, systems, and details required to ship.

reel._note: Wordless transition after Select Work (Version 1.7): three rows of frames that move sideways with the scroll, the top and bottom rows to the right and the middle row to the left, at slightly different rates. Every frame is a placeholder until the content pull; replace a { "ratio": "16:9" } frame with { "asset": "<manifest id>" } to show that approved image in the same frame. The label is for screen readers only.
reel.label: More of the work

practice._note: Version 1.7: What I Do and How I Work combined into one section. The How I Work statement is temporary copy awaiting approval. Stack tools show their mark from stack-icons.json (Simple Icons) when one exists and their name only otherwise.
practice.heading: From positioning to production.

how.label: How I Work
how.copy: I move comfortably between strategy and execution. I work best with clear ownership, direct collaboration, and systems that make good work repeatable. AI speeds up research, organization, production, and analysis; judgment, verification, brand fit, and final approval stay with me.

about._note: About (Version 1.7): the static headline, then three paragraphs (the music and business foundation, the move to Phi Labs Global and the wider scope, and the concluding positioning line, set a step larger), the resume action on the concluding row, a thin rule and the trust bar, composed so the whole section fits one desktop frame. Double asterisks mark the three approved highlights, rendered in blue-teal at a slightly heavier weight; nothing else is bold. The complete text is in the HTML; with JavaScript and motion allowed its words flow in once, in reading order, when About comes into view.
about.heading: Creative instincts. Operator discipline.

paragraphs.text: I came to DeFi in 2021 after a decade of building audiences and running the business behind a **globally distributed music project**, securing sponsorships, media appearances, and major bookings.

In 2024, I joined Phi Labs Global to manage social across a product portfolio reaching **more than 200,000 people**. As the company evolved, my role expanded into positioning, technical documentation and websites, partnerships and KOL management, and campaigns and distribution.
Today, I turn product complexity into **market narratives** people understand and connect with.

contact.heading: Make the complex impossible to ignore.
contact.copy: I’m interested in remote Web3 marketing roles and open to the right opportunity in AI or technical products.
